canonical_rule: English is the canonical source. Localized editions are translations of the same content identity, never independent duplicate canonicals.
content_key_rule: Use the English canonical slug/content key for all language editions.
publication_rule: A translation may be draft or published independently, but cannot replace or redefine the English canonical source.
seo_rule: When localized public routes are enabled, emit self-canonical plus hreflang links for available published languages and x-default to English.
